subject.title: Subagent lifecycle observability + async supervision controls

question: Should subagent lifecycle receipts and cancel/steer/resume supervision be modeled by extending the existing audit/task/artifact foundations, or by creating a separate subagent-specific ledger and API?
rationale: The remaining work fixes a durable public contract for security scopes, persisted data shape, redaction, retention, and operator semantics; automation should not choose that boundary alone.

options.title: Extend existing foundations
options.body: Add subagent lifecycle and supervision event types over the current metadata-only audit ledger, task summaries, artifact lookup, and subagent registry data.

options.title: Create subagent-specific ledger
options.body: Add a dedicated subagent event/control table and API, accepting another durable source of truth for this operator workflow.

options.title: Keep current summaries only
options.body: Decline the durable receipt/control contract for now and leave audit.list, tasks, artifacts, and subagent commands as separate operator tools.

recommendation.title: Extend existing foundations
recommendation.body: Add subagent lifecycle and supervision event types over the current metadata-only audit ledger, task summaries, artifact lookup, and subagent registry data.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history across the audit, SQLite state, subagent control, and task lifecycle surfaces involved in this contract choice.
